children.value: > Fact From Story: Algorithms that reap advertising profits from maximizing time-on-site have figured out that what keeps us clicking is anger.

> > > > > Fact From Story: There’s the constant distraction from the climate crisis, in the form of the churning scandals of the day, in an attention economy where all topics compete for mental energy.
> > > > > Commonsense Knowledge: People have a limited capacity for attention.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: People tend to focus on what makes them angry.
> Fact From Story: The possibilities of climate action exist within a media ecosystem that has monetized our attention and that profits from our hate and division.
> Commonsense Knowledge: An obstacle makes it difficult to achieve a goal.
